title: Choosing Surgery After Years of Hesitation
paragraphs: Selama hampir lima tahun, Junaidi menunda operasi yang direkomendasikan untuk kondisi kronisnya, mengelola gejala hanya melalui obat sambil diam-diam takut proses pemulihan akan mengganggu pekerjaan dan tanggung jawab keluarganya secara signifikan.

Seiring kondisinya secara bertahap memburuk meski dengan obat, membatasi kegiatan yang sebelumnya ia anggap biasa saja, Junaidi akhirnya berkonsultasi dengan spesialis yang menjelaskan secara terus terang seberapa besar penundaan itu telah meningkatkan kompleksitas prosedurnya.

Menghadapi informasi ini secara langsung, alih-alih terus menunda tanpa batas, Junaidi menjadwalkan operasinya, mengatur terlebih dahulu agar saudaranya mengelola tanggung jawabnya selama masa pemulihan enam minggu yang telah ia hindari selama bertahun-tahun.

Merenungkan setelah pemulihan yang berhasil, Junaidi mengakui bahwa tahun-tahun keraguannya, yang terutama didorong ketakutan alih-alih kendala praktis sesungguhnya, telah merenggutnya ketidaknyamanan yang jauh lebih besar daripada yang akhirnya dituntut operasi itu sendiri.
answerKey: For nearly five years, Junaidi postponed a recommended surgery for a chronic condition, managing symptoms through medication alone while quietly fearing the recovery process would disrupt his work and family responsibilities significantly. As his condition gradually worsened despite medication, limiting activities he had previously taken entirely for granted, Junaidi finally consulted a specialist who explained candidly how much the delay had already increased the procedure's complexity. Facing this information directly, rather than continuing indefinite postponement, Junaidi scheduled the surgery, arranging in advance for his brother to manage his responsibilities during the six-week recovery period he had been avoiding for years. Reflecting after a successful recovery, Junaidi acknowledges that his years of hesitation, driven primarily by fear rather than genuine practical constraints, had cost him considerably more discomfort than the surgery itself ultimately required.
